flow.name: axn-term - claude conversation restore
flow.description: A fresh claude launch replaces the remembered conversation; closing axn-term interrupts claude (Ctrl-C pair), captures the id from its exit hint, and reopening resumes exactly that conversation.

step.description: Create a temp state dir with a fake claude binary
Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
Launch a fresh claude in the session
Close axn-term — claude is interrupted and its resume id captured

assert.description: The app closed and saved state

step.description: Reopen axn-term and verify the exact conversation is resumed
